title: LCT: Losslessly Compressed Tensors with GPU friendly execution for Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.22179v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Lossless tensor compression could reduce memory usage during training, but training requires tensors to be repeatedly re-encoded. We introduce Losslessly Compressed Tensors (LCT), a GPU execution framework designed for this repeated encode-decode regime. LCT exploits the natural redundancy in floating point data to reduce storage for weights, activations and optimizer states. Highly optimized GPU kernels implement Huffman coding with precomputed codebooks for low compression and decompression overhead, essential for training. Our analysis characterizes LCT's storage costs and adaptation to magnitude shifts. LCT achieves a compression ratio of up to $1.455\times$, and is demonstrated in training and finetuning settings. On a 162M-parameter NanoGPT, LCT reduces memory usage by $24.6\%$ for a $7.2\%$ step-time increase. In Qwen3-4B fine-tuning, LCT saves up to $23.8\%$ of peak memory, enabling a $3.5\times$ larger context length in training

translated_title: LCT：面向训练的GPU友好执行无损压缩张量
translated_abstract: 无损张量压缩可以减少训练期间的内存使用，但训练需要张量被反复重新编码。我们提出了无损压缩张量（LCT），一个专为这种反复编码-解码模式设计的GPU执行框架。LCT利用浮点数据中天然存在的冗余性来减少权重、激活值和优化器状态的存储空间。高度优化的GPU内核实现了基于预计算码本的霍夫曼编码，从而将压缩和解压缩的开销降到最低，这对训练至关重要。我们的分析刻画了LCT的存储成本及其对数值幅度变化的适应能力。LCT实现了高达1.455倍的压缩比，并在训练和微调场景中得到了验证。在一个1.62亿参数的NanoGPT上，LCT以7.2%的步进时间增加为代价，减少了24.6%的内存使用。在Qwen3-4B的微调中，LCT节省了高达23.8%的峰值内存，使训练时的上下文长度得以扩大3.5倍。
tldr: LCT提出了一个GPU友好的无损张量压缩执行框架，利用浮点数据冗余和优化的霍夫曼编码内核，在几乎不增加训练时间的情况下实现高达1.455倍压缩比，将训练内存占用降低最多24.6%并支持3.5倍的更长上下文。
en_tdlr: LCT is a GPU execution framework for losslessly compressed tensors that exploits floating-point redundancy via highly optimized Huffman coding kernels, achieving up to 1.455x compression with minimal step-time overhead, reducing training memory usage by up to 24.6% and enabling 3.5x longer context lengths.
